posts.title: ARM Macs can (sometimes) easily debug iOS AppStore applications
posts.description: Caveats apply, but when it works, it works really well. On a good day, iOS apps can be debugged on an ARM Mac painlessly. The secret sauce is PlayCover , which is a free, open-source tool that convinces ARM Macs to run iOS apps. posts.title: A year with ViewQwest's 10Gbps broadband
posts.description: I still find it unreal that 10Gbps internet access at a reasonable rate is a thing, but here we are! posts.title: RGB delete on a cheap(ish) keyboard
posts.description: I recently bought this “Yinren R108” keyboard off Taobao and there’s a lot to like about it. It’s a simple 108-key keyboard with preinstalled hot-swappable Peach V3 switches, and is well priced at about S$88 (~US$70).
